thread:
leah_cs: Heads-up — Asterion dedicated bring-up next week. Need final quota, autoscale policy, load test start time, and rollback plan. Renewal review depends on meeting latency targets.

sam: what quota did sales lock? I have a rough cluster plan but need concrete numbers.

leah_cs: Sales confirmed reserved 3xA100, burst allowed to 5 for up to 20m. They expect stable p95 < 150ms on normal traffic.

jia: from our pre-prod runs, median reqs ~60/min, 95th ~420/min. avg tokens ~260. I'll attach the traffic profile to the runbook.

olivia: OK SLO: p95 <150ms baseline, allow short bursts to 200ms for up to 20min. Fallback: route to quantized-cpu model if latency degrades >2x.

sam: proposed autoscale rule: scale when queue_time_ms > 120 for 20s, add 1 replica, max 5. scale down after 4m stable under 80ms. Enable KV prefix warmup on scale-up.

jia: tested policy in staging — looks stable. snippet below:

```
autoscale:
  trigger: queue_time_ms
  up_threshold: 120
  up_duration: 20s
  step: 1
  max_replicas: 5
  down_duration: 240s
  warmup: true
```

jia: priming command: `./primer --profile asterion-warm.json --concurrency 6` — fills KV cache and embeddings cache.

leah_cs: Load test window? customer prefers early morning to avoid traffic. Can we do Tue 06:30 PT?

sam: Tue 06:30 PT works. Plan: 10m ramp to 70% of reserved, 25m soak at 100% reserved, 20m burst to 150% (limited by max_replicas). I'll create the pool with reserve=3, max=5 and attach dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/asterion-summary

olivia: Add a readiness probe that returns ok only after primer completes (prevents routing to cold workers). Also include a health signal to disable autoscale during the primer.

jia: Will add a simple /health returning {"state":"primed"} once primer done. PR incoming.

leah_cs: Ops checklist for the run: support on-call assigned, KMS access verified, and customer will validate warmup acceptance. I'll run the acceptance script with them.

sam: smoke test curl for quick validation:

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/infer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"asterion-v2","inputs":["hello"]}'
```

leah_cs: Action items: sam -> create pool + attach autoscale policy + post pool id; jia -> primer + health-check PR; olivia -> update runbook with fallback routing and rollback steps; leah_cs -> confirm customer presence and run acceptance during test.

sam: on it. will post pool id and Grafana link on this thread when ready. :thumbsup:

aj autoscale-bot: Autoscale policy validated and scheduled for deployment to the new pool.

olivia: final pre-check Fri 16:00 PT. If anything looks off we'll roll to hosted fallback. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
